title: AlgoDive Performance Report
description: Machine-readable output of the automated frame-timing suite. This is the contract FR-015 requires the suite to emit and FR-017 compares against committed baselines. Steady-state figures gate pass/fail; warm-up figures are reported, never discarded.

label.description: Which side of the comparison this file is. 'before' MUST be captured on an unmodified tree.

device.description: Device identifier. Must be 'oppo-a5i' for a gating run (FR-001).

buildMode.description: A value of 'debug' invalidates the entire run — debug frame numbers are not representative and are banned by the spec.

thermalState.description: Whether the device was cold or soaked for 10 minutes before the run (SC-008).

scenarioId.description: Stable identifier, reused across before/after so the two can be paired.

steadyState.description: The ONLY phase that gates pass/fail.

warmup.description: Reported against the SC-011 allowance. MUST be present — warm-up frames are classified, never silently discarded (FR-020).

tabSwitchMs.description: Present only for tab-switch scenarios. Gate: < 300 (SC-006).

samples.description: Optional raw per-frame data. Useful for diagnosis; not required for the gate.

overBudgetFrameCount.description: Frames exceeding 16.67ms. Steady-state gate: must be 0 (SC-001, SC-002). Warm-up allowance: at most 5 (SC-011).

durationMs.description: For warm-up: must reach steady state within 500ms (SC-011).

rasterTimeMs.description: GPU raster cost — where backdrop-blur cost appears.
